cohort_description: 24 untreated PDAC tumors and 11 control pancreases
inclusion_reason: Foundational primary single-cell dataset with patient-level identifiers, sufficient malignant epithelial cells, and untreated primary tumors suitable for pseudobulk validation.
notes: Authoritative Peng et al. (2019) dataset. Primary GSA accession CRA001160; BioProject PRJCA001063. Formally separated from GSE111672.

cohort_description: single-cell and spatial data from six pancreatic cancer patients
inclusion_reason: Smaller cohort (n=6) combining single-cell and spatial profiling, suitable for spatial validation and secondary cellular-source evaluation.
notes: Authoritative Moncada et al. (2020) dataset. Contains single-cell and spatial data. Formally separated from Peng 2019.

cohort_description: 10 primary PDAC tumors and 6 metastatic biopsies
inclusion_reason: Public processed data is available. Primary tumors (n=10) can be analyzed separately from metastatic lesions (n=6). Suitable for patient-aware pseudobulk.
notes: Lin et al. (2020) Genome Med. Often confused in legacy records with Steele et al. (2020) controlled-access CD45+ sorted dataset.

cohort_description: 43 primary PDAC specimens with single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomics
inclusion_reason: Large dual-modality snRNA-seq and spatial dataset. Highly suitable for spatial validation (Layer 3) and secondary/treatment-sensitivity cellular source evaluation (Layer 2).
notes: Lin et al. (2023) / Hwang et al. (2022) Nature Genetics. Contains both single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomics.
